text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Commander of the U.S. Forces Central Command General Peay pledges to keep Strait of Hormuz open.
- The Middle East's unemployment rate is rising, Bahraini finance minister told a gathering in Abu Dhabi.
- More than 100 companies will take part in the first Algerian Exhibition in Bahrain to be held this month.
- Crown Prince discusses with U.S army commander ways of boosting military cooperation.
- About 50 Bahraini firms to participate in "Made in Bahrain" exhibition to be held in Jordan in June.
- Real estate prices rise by between five and seven percent.
